claims.headline: Follows a whole-food vegan diet she credits for sustained energy and clear skin
claims.body: Petsch has spoken openly about maintaining a strictly vegan, whole-food diet built around oats, brown rice, quinoa, black beans, spinach, and avocado. In interviews she has described her typical day of eating as meal-by-meal structured around plant staples rather than processed substitutes, and she has noted that clean plant-based eating supports both her energy levels on set and her skin clarity.

sources.excerpt: Petsch walks through her day of eating, describing a whole-food vegan approach anchored by oats, grains, legumes, and leafy greens.

claims.headline: Describes veganism as a lifestyle commitment rooted in ethics and environmental care, not just diet
claims.body: Petsch has consistently framed her veganism as extending beyond food to encompass a broader ethical commitment to animal welfare and environmental sustainability. She has described plant-based eating as the natural expression of values she holds across all areas of her life.

sources.excerpt: Madelaine Petsch explains that her vegan lifestyle goes beyond food — it is rooted in a commitment to animal welfare and the environment.
